description: This file implements the CalDAVProvider class for interfacing with CalDAV calendar servers, including functionality for connecting, testing connection, fetching, creating, updating, and deleting calendar events, along with parsing iCalendar data.

classes.name: CalDAVProvider
classes.description: A provider class that handles communication with CalDAV calendar servers using HTTP Basic Authentication, supporting operations such as test connection, get/create/update/delete events, and parsing iCalendar data.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the CalDAV server, verifying credentials and server availability.

methods.name: getAuthHeaders
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTTP headers needed for Basic Authentication with the server.

methods.name: getCalendarUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the CalDAV calendar URL from the connection configuration.

methods.name: makeCalDAVRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the CalDAV server with specified method, URL, headers, and body, returning the response code and body.

methods.name: buildPropfindXml
methods.description: Builds an XML body for the PROPFIND request to discover calendar properties.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events from the CalDAV server based on the specified query parameters.

methods.name: formatDateTimeAsUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC and formats it according to iCalendar standards.

methods.name: buildCalendarQueryXml
methods.description: Constructs the XML body for calendar-query REPORT requests, optionally filtered by time range.

methods.name: parseCalendarQueryResponse
methods.description: Parses the XML response from a calendar-query REPORT to extract individual calendar events.

methods.name: parseICalendarData
methods.description: Parses an iCalendar (ICS) data string into a CalendarAccountEvent object.

methods.name: parseICalDateTime
methods.description: Parses a date-time string from iCalendar format into a DateTime object.

methods.name: calculateEndDateFromDuration
methods.description: Calculates an end date based on a start date and an ISO 8601 duration string.

methods.name: unescapeICalValue
methods.description: Unescapes special characters in iCalendar data fields.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific calendar event by its ID from the server.

methods.name: convertToICalendar
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into an iCalendar formatted string.

methods.name: escapeICalValue
methods.description: Escapes special characters in values to conform with iCalendar format.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event on the server, converting the event object into iCalendar format.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event on the server.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event from the server.
